reason: The price is fine for a school our size, but this is sign up online and do it yourself. My office staff are not comfortable with computers, and I don't have time to run a 14-day trial and type in 900 students' data myself after answering parents on WhatsApp till midnight.
objection: Who will come to the school, train my staff and enter our data? Nothing here says anyone will. If it sits half-set-up, I've paid for software nobody uses.
would_change_my_mind: A person visits the school, imports our student and fee data, and trains the office staff and teachers on-site before we start paying, even if that costs extra.
